instructions.task: Hate-speech annotation of a tweet under a policy covering hate against immigrants/refugees and against women. Which description best fits this tweet?
key_rules: Supporting restrictive immigration policy (the wall, ICE, ending DACA, deportation) is NOT hate by itself. Hashtags such as #BuildThatWall, #DeportThemAll or #SendThemBack attached to political commentary, news or a hashtag stack do not make a tweet hateful.

An immigration tweet is hate when its own words generalise immigrants as criminals, rapists, thieves, invaders or a plague, or when its own words demand that immigrants/illegal aliens be removed, sent home or gotten rid of.
Tweets using 'bitch' (or cunt) as slang, an exclamation, self-reference, lyrics or an ordinary insult in a personal beef are NOT hate.

A tweet about women is hate when it sexually degrades or threatens a woman because she is a woman (rape threats or jokes, sexual humiliation, wishing sexual violence or death on her) or demeans women as a group.
Calling a woman or women hoes/whores/sluts (labelling women by sexual promiscuity) is hate, whether aimed at one woman or at women generally (e.g. 'chasing hoes').

criteria.immigrants_criminalised: The tweet's own words portray immigrants, refugees or illegal aliens as a group as criminals, rapists, child molesters, thieves stealing jobs/benefits, disease carriers, invaders, vermin or an invasion. Also: sharing crime news or statistics to imply illegal aliens are typically predators or killers, and claims that an immigrant ethnicity (e.g. Mestizos) turns a country into a third-world shithole.
criteria.immigrants_expel_demand: The tweet's own text (not just a hashtag) demands immigrants/illegal aliens be deported, sent home, gotten rid of or kept out, as its main message.
criteria.immigration_commentary: Immigration politics without demeaning immigrants as people: support for the wall, ICE, ending DACA, legal-vs-illegal distinctions, jabs at Democrats or Trump, news links, rally posts, hashtag stacks, or defending the term 'illegal alien'. Complaints about how politicians spend money or treat citizens, ending in a #SendThemHome-style hashtag, belong here unless the tweet also portrays immigrants as criminals or a hazard.
criteria.woman_sexually_degraded: Sexually degrades, humiliates or threatens a woman as a woman: rape threats or jokes, graphic sexual insults about her body or sexual acts, wishing violence or death on her.
criteria.women_generalised: Demeaning generalisations about women as a group (women are whores, only good for sex, deserve rape).
criteria.woman_called_hoe: Calls a woman or women hoe(s), whore(s) or slut(s), degrading them for their sexuality, e.g. 'you a hoe', 'chasing hoes', 'drag a hoe'.
criteria.bitch_insult: Uses 'bitch' or 'cunt' as an ordinary insult or form of address in an argument or complaint, without calling anyone a hoe/whore/slut and without sexual degradation or threats.
criteria.casual_slur: 'Bitch' as filler, exclamation, self-description, affection between friends, or song lyrics.
criteria.other_insult_or_report: Insults a man, politician or thing; reports or criticises someone else's sexism or racism; or anything unrelated to women or immigrants.
